description: This file implements an AttendanceRepository class that manages attendance data by interfacing with remote API sources and local database sources. It encapsulates methods for inserting attendance records marked at the current time, and retrieving records by date or week start date, depending on configuration.

classes.name: AttendanceRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages attendance data operations, handling both remote API calls and local database storage, depending on environment configuration.

methods.name: AttendanceRepository
methods.description: Constructor for AttendanceRepository, requiring a local database source.

methods.name: insertNow
methods.description: Inserts a new attendance record at the current UTC time, attempting remote insertion if enabled, otherwise falling back to local database storage.

methods.name: getByDate
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for a specific date, from remote API or local database based on configuration.

methods.name: getByWeekStart
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for a week starting from the given date, either from remote API or local database.
